messages:
pat: Quick postmortem follow-up 19. We saw an egress stability regression during the rollback window causing retries and TLS timeouts. Dropping action items here.

hema: I can own the route-diff inventory and who changed what. ETA Tuesday EOD.

ollie: Ill correlate TLS client-side failures (SNI, handshake time) with pats timeline.

zara: Captured a short pcap showing SYN retransmits then connection reset ~2s later. Looks like route churn before TLS complete.

hema: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) alert when cross-region egress retry rate >1.5% for 5m, 2) temporary increase route stabilization window 10s->60s, 3) enable local-eject fallback on affected pools.

ollie: +1 on alerts and playbook. Ill open PR to infra-alerts and add a playbook snippet. ETA Wed morning.

pat: Owners/due dates: route inventory (hema) Tue EOD; TLS correlation (ollie) Wed AM; alert+playbook (ollie) Wed PM; canary testing (zara & hema) next Fri. 30m sync Thursday to review.

sre-bot: Reminder: add actions to incident tracker -> https://redwood.tools/incidents/2198887776

pat: Please post PR links in this thread and tag with incidents:2198887776. If anyone notices new spikes, paste region + pod id + short logs here. Closing for today; will reopen at Thu sync.
